custom_logic_notes: Spreader is a statistical arbitrage / pairs trading EA. It simultaneously opens long on one symbol and short on another when the spread between them deviates from its historical mean beyond a threshold. The core logic involves: (1) calculating the real-time spread between two correlated instruments, (2) comparing the spread to statistical thresholds (mean +/- N standard deviations or fixed pip deviation), (3) entering a pair trade when the spread is extreme - buying the underperforming symbol and selling the overperforming one, (4) exiting when the spread reverts to mean or crosses to the opposite side. This requires simultaneous execution on two symbols which is a multi-symbol hedging pattern not convertible to simple directional trading. Position sizing may include hedge ratio calculation to keep the pair dollar-neutral or beta-neutral.
python_conversion_notes: This EA implements pairs/statistical arbitrage requiring simultaneous positions on two symbols. Python conversion needs: (1) dual-symbol data feed with synchronized timestamps, (2) custom spread calculation engine (price difference or ratio with rolling mean/std), (3) simultaneous order execution on both legs with proper hedge ratio sizing, (4) position tracking across two symbols as a single 'pair trade' unit, (5) spread mean-reversion exit logic. Cannot use standard single-symbol backtesting framework. Recommend building a dedicated pairs trading backtester with dual-symbol position management.
